## 数据准备与库加载

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
library(cowplot)
library(pheatmap)

# 分类树解析函数
tax_levels = c("domain", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species")

parse_taxonomy = function(tax_str) {
    if (is.na(tax_str)) return(set_names(rep(NA_character_, 7), tax_levels))
    parts = str_split_1(tax_str, ";\\s*")
    names(parts) = tax_levels[seq_along(parts)]
    parts
}

# 全局路径设置
ROOT <- getwd()

# WGS 完整基因组比较结果（7 株分离株完整基因组：ANI、mummer dotplot）
WGS_CG_DIR <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "processed", "genomic-sequencing",
                        "comparative-genomics")
WGS_ANI_DIR <- file.path(WGS_CG_DIR, "ani")
DOTPLOT_DIR <- file.path(WGS_CG_DIR, "dotplot")

# MAG vs WGS 完整基因组参考的比较结果（共线性、SNP）
MAG_CG_DIR <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "processed", "metagenomic-sequencing",
                        "comparative-genomics")
SYNT_COMPLETE_DIR <- file.path(MAG_CG_DIR, "synteny_vs_complete")
SNP_COMPLETE_DIR <- file.path(MAG_CG_DIR, "snps_vs_complete")

# MAG bin 重命名映射：全部 MAG 按自然排序统一编号为 bin01-bin54，
# 供共线性面板（I）中 MAG query 的简洁标签使用
all_bins = c(
    read.csv(file.path(MAG_CG_DIR, "ani", "Pantoea_ani_matrix.csv"), check.names = FALSE)[[1]],
    read.csv(file.path(MAG_CG_DIR, "ani", "Burkholderia_ani_matrix.csv"), check.names = FALSE)[[1]]
) |>
    unique() |>
    str_sort(numeric = TRUE)

bin_map = setNames(sprintf("bin%02d", seq_along(all_bins)), all_bins)
```

## A: Isolation composition

### 数据准备

```{r}
#| label: isolation-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# 种子材料信息
seed_bank = read_csv("data/processed/seed-bank/seed-bank.csv")

# 测序样品表
sequencing_table = read_csv("data/processed/16s-rrna-gene/sanger_sequencing_sample_table.csv") |>
    dplyr::select(tss_id, sequence_id, sample_id) |>
    dplyr::rename(glycerol_stock_id = sample_id) |>
    mutate(isolate_id = str_remove(glycerol_stock_id, "-R[0-9]+$"))

# BLAST 分类鉴定结果
blast_result_file = "data/processed/16s-rrna-gene/20250319_filtered_blast_taxonomy.txt"
colnames = "qseqid sseqid pident length evalue bitscore staxids sscinames stitle" |>
    str_split_1(" ")
strain_taxonomy = read_tsv(blast_result_file, col_names = colnames) |>
    group_by(qseqid) |>
    slice_max(order_by = bitscore, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    dplyr::select(sequence_id = qseqid, taxid = staxids, percent_identity = pident) |>
    left_join(sequencing_table, by = "sequence_id")

# 完整分类树
full_taxonomy = read_csv("data/processed/16s-rrna-gene/20250319_taxonomy.csv") |>
    dplyr::select(sequencing_id, full_taxonomy = taxonomy) |>
    mutate(sequencing_id = str_remove(sequencing_id, "\\.ab1$"))

strain_taxonomy = strain_taxonomy |>
    left_join(full_taxonomy, by = c("sequence_id" = "sequencing_id")) |>
    mutate(taxonomy = if_else(is.na(full_taxonomy), NA_character_, full_taxonomy)) |>
    dplyr::select(-full_taxonomy)
```

### Barplot + Piechart 组合

```{r}
#| label: isolation-barplot-pieplot
#| fig-cap: "分离株属水平组成分析 (A) 按位置分布的属级组成柱状图 (B) 内生菌与外生菌比例"
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# 数据处理
high_quality_assignment = strain_taxonomy |>
    filter(percent_identity > 90) |>
    group_by(isolate_id) |>
    slice_max(percent_identity)

data = high_quality_assignment |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
        parsed = list(parse_taxonomy(taxonomy)),
        genus = parsed[["genus"]],
        species = parsed[["species"]]
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    # 统一 Burkholderia 复合分支名（与 panel B 一致）
    mutate(genus = if_else(genus == "Burkholderia-Caballeronia-Paraburkholderia",
                           "Burkholderia", genus)) |>
    separate(isolate_id, c("field_id", "user", "medium", "location", "no"),
             sep = "-", extra = "merge", remove = FALSE) |>
    left_join(seed_bank, by = "field_id") |>
    dplyr::select(field_id, genus, location, genetic_group, material_type) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(genus)) |>
    dplyr::filter(location %in% c("EN", "EP"))

# EN/EP 共享配色（bar 与 pie 对齐）
location_colors = c(EN = "#F8766D", EP = "#00BFC4")

# A: 属级组成柱状图（保留 Top 8 属，其余归为 Other）
bar_counts = data |>
    mutate(genus = fct_lump_n(genus, n = 8, other_level = "Other")) |>
    count(genus, location) |>
    mutate(
        genus = fct_reorder(genus, n, .fun = sum, .desc = TRUE),
        genus = fct_relevel(genus, "Other", after = Inf)
    )

p_bar = bar_counts |>
    ggplot(aes(genus, n, fill = location)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = location_colors) +
    labs(x = "Genus", y = "Number of isolates") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "none")

# B: 内生菌与外生菌饼图（作为 inset 嵌入 A，不显示图例）
p_pie = data |>
    count(location) |>
    mutate(proportion = n / sum(n) * 100) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = "", y = n, fill = location)) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = str_glue("{location}\n{round(proportion, 1)}%")),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.6) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = location_colors) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

# 组合图：饼图嵌入柱状图右上方空旷区。
# 注意：用 annotation_custom 而非 inset_element —— 后者会把 f4a 变成嵌套
# patchwork 对象，导致拼图中 tag "a" 锚点偏移到面板中部；改用单一 grob 嵌入后
# f4a 仍是普通 ggplot，tag 可正确锚定在左上角。x 用离散类别位置（1..9），
# y 用堆叠柱高的比例定位，宽高比按数据坐标匹配以保持饼图为圆形。
y_max = bar_counts |> summarise(total = sum(n), .by = genus) |> pull(total) |> max()

f4a = p_bar +
    annotation_custom(ggplotGrob(p_pie),
                      xmin = 3.5, xmax = 8.5,
                      ymin = 0.39 * y_max, ymax = 0.94 * y_max)
f4a
```

## B: Amplicon composition

### 方法比较 Dotplot

```{r}
#| label: amplicon-isolation-dotplot
#| fig-cap: "扩增子测序与菌株分离方法的属级组成比较"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(microeco)

# 读取扩增子数据并构建 microtable 对象
PATH = "data/processed/amplicon-sequencing/seed-water-all/"

# OTU 表
otu_table = read_csv(file.path(PATH, "asv-table-rawcount.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
otu_table = column_to_rownames(otu_table, var = names(otu_table)[1])
otu_table <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table))

# 样品表
seed_bank_info = read_csv("data/processed/seed-bank/seed-bank.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
sample_table = read_csv(file.path(PATH, "sample-info.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  left_join(seed_bank_info) |>
  mutate(genetic_group = fct_relevel(genetic_group, c("SS","TST","NSS","3K","Tibet")))
sample_table = column_to_rownames(sample_table, var = names(sample_table)[1])

# 分类表
taxon_table = read_csv(file.path(PATH, "tax-table.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
taxon_table = column_to_rownames(taxon_table, var = names(taxon_table)[1])
taxon_table = taxon_table |>
  mutate(Genus = if_else(Genus == "Burkholderia-Caballeronia-Paraburkholderia", "Burkholderia", Genus))

# 构建 microtable 对象
mt = microtable$new(otu_table = otu_table, sample_table = sample_table, tax_table = taxon_table)
mt$sample_table = subset(mt$sample_table, genetic_group != "LocalSeed")
mt$tidy_dataset()
mt$tax_table = subset(mt$tax_table, !is.na(Phylum))
mt$tidy_dataset()

# 计算属水平的物种丰度
amplicon_genus = trans_abund$new(dataset = mt, taxrank = "Genus", ntaxa = 50)

# 获取属级相对丰度数据
amplicon_genus_df = amplicon_genus$data_abund |>
    group_by(Taxonomy) |>
    summarise(mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    rename(Genus = Taxonomy) |>
    filter(Genus != "NA", mean_abundance > 0.5) |>
    arrange(desc(mean_abundance))

# 读取分离株数据
isolation_tax = read_csv("data/processed/16s-rrna-gene/20250319_taxonomy.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

isolation_tax = isolation_tax |>
    separate(taxonomy, into = c("domain","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species"),
             sep = ";", fill = "right", remove = FALSE) |>
    mutate(genus = if_else(is.na(genus) | genus == "", "unclassified", genus)) |>
    mutate(genus = if_else(genus == "Burkholderia-Caballeronia-Paraburkholderia", "Burkholderia", genus))

isolation_tax = isolation_tax |>
    mutate(sample_id_clean = str_remove(sample_id, "-R\\d+$")) |>
    mutate(variant_code = str_split_i(sample_id_clean, "-", 6))

isolation_tax_dedup = isolation_tax |>
    group_by(sample_id_clean) |>
    slice_max(order_by = nchar(taxonomy), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup()

# 计算分离株属级比例
isolation_genus_df = isolation_tax_dedup |>
    count(genus, name = "count") |>
    filter(genus != "unclassified") |>
    mutate(total = sum(count)) |>
    mutate(proportion = count / total * 100) |>
    select(genus, count, proportion) |>
    filter(proportion > 0.5) |>
    arrange(desc(proportion))

# 合并两种方法的属级比例
comparison_df = amplicon_genus_df |>
    select(Genus, amplicon_abundance = mean_abundance) |>
    full_join(
        isolation_genus_df |>
            select(Genus = genus, isolation_proportion = proportion),
        by = "Genus"
    ) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0))) |>
    filter(Genus != "unclassified")

# 绘制散点图（标注文字配色/字号与 c、d 面板一致：按 Genus 着色、size = 2；
# 降低 max.overlaps，密集区域自动隐藏部分标签，避免文字过密）
p_scatter = ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = amplicon_abundance, y = isolation_proportion)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Genus), size = 3, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        aes(label = Genus, color = Genus),
        size = 2, max.overlaps = 8, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "Amplicon (%)", y = "Isolation (%)") +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

# Spearman 相关标注（b/c/d 三个散点面板共用的辅助函数）
# Spearman 基于秩次，与是否取 log 无关
cor_label = function(x, y) {
    ct = cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    sprintf("Spearman r = %.2f, P %s", unname(ct$estimate),
            ifelse(ct$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", ct$p.value)))
}

# 以居中 subtitle 形式标注相关系数（不遮挡数据点）
f4b = p_scatter +
    labs(subtitle = cor_label(comparison_df$amplicon_abundance,
                              comparison_df$isolation_proportion)) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

f4b
```

### 自交系 vs 农家种 Dotplot

```{r}
#| label: inbred-landrace-dotplot
#| fig-cap: "自交系与农家种的属级组成比较"
#| fig-width: 8

    filter(!is.na(material_type)) |>
    group_by(material_type, genus) |>
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(proportion = n / sum(n) * 100, .by = material_type) |>

f4c = comp_c |>
    ggplot(aes(`inbred lines`, landraces)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = genus), show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = genus, color = genus), size = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "Inbred line relative abundance (%)",
         y = "Landrace relative abundance (%)",
         subtitle = cor_label(comp_c$`inbred lines`, comp_c$landraces)) +

f4c
```

### EN vs EP Dotplot

```{r}
#| label: en-ep-dotplot
#| fig-cap: "内生菌与外生菌的属级组成比较"
#| fig-width: 8

comp_d = data |>
    group_by(location, genus) |>

    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "Endophyte relative abundance (%)",
         y = "Epiphyte relative abundance (%)",
         subtitle = cor_label(comp_d$EN, comp_d$EP)) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

## C: ANI heatmap

### 7 株完整基因组 ANI 热图

```{r}
#| label: ani-heatmap-wgs
#| fig-cap: "7 株完整基因组 ANI 热图（按物种排列）"
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: 100%
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# 读取 7 株完整基因组的 fastANI 矩阵
mat_ani <- read.csv(file.path(WGS_ANI_DIR, "all_ani_matrix.csv"),
                    row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
mat_ani[mat_ani == ""] <- NA
mat_ani <- as.matrix(mat_ani)
mode(mat_ani) <- "numeric"
diag(mat_ani) <- 100

# 按物种手动排序：P. dispersa → P. stewartii → B. gladioli
# （跨属 ANI 未计算，以灰色 NA 显示，凸显 3 个物种的聚类区块）
strain_order <- c("D011P03", "D119N01",      # P. dispersa
                  "D018P05", "D113N10",      # P. stewartii
                  "D014P08", "D053P02", "D112P05")  # B. gladioli
mat_ani <- mat_ani[strain_order, strain_order]

# 物种分组注释（行）
anno_row <- data.frame(
    Species = c("P. dispersa", "P. dispersa",
                "P. stewartii", "P. stewartii",
                "B. gladioli", "B. gladioli", "B. gladioli"),
    row.names = strain_order
)

# 数值标签矩阵：跨属 NA 单元格留空，避免显示 "NA"
num_mat <- ifelse(is.na(mat_ani), "", sprintf("%.1f", mat_ani))

f4e = pheatmap(mat_ani,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#D73027", "#FDAE61", "#FFFFBF",
                                     "#A6D96A", "#1A9641"))(100),
         breaks = seq(75, 100, length.out = 101),
         na_col = "grey90",
         cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         annotation_row = anno_row,
         annotation_colors = list(Species = c("P. dispersa" = "#4DBBD5",
                                              "P. stewartii" = "#287D8E",
                                              "B. gladioli" = "#E64B35")),
         annotation_legend = FALSE,
         display_numbers = num_mat,
         fontsize_number = 5, number_color = "grey20",
         border_color = "white",
         fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 7,
         angle_col = 45,
         silent = TRUE) |>
    ggplotify::as.ggplot()

f4e
```

## D: Mummer dotplot

### 种内共线性点图（nucmer）

每个物种取一个种内代表比对：X 轴为参考基因组，Y 轴为查询基因组。红色为正向比对（对角线方向），蓝色为反向比对（反对角线，反映反转事件）。

```{r}
#| label: mummer-dotplots
#| fig-cap: "mummer 种内共线性点图（P. dispersa / P. stewartii / B. gladioli 各一代表）"
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: 100%
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# 加载 show-coords 解析与 dot plot 绘制函数
source(file.path(ROOT, "scripts", "genomic-sequencing", "synteny_viz.R"))

# 每个物种的种内代表比对对
dotplot_pairs <- c("D011P03_vs_D119N01" = "P. dispersa",
                   "D018P05_vs_D113N10" = "P. stewartii",
                   "D112P05_vs_D014P08" = "B. gladioli")

# 生成并统一美化三个点图
dotplot_list <- lapply(names(dotplot_pairs), function(lbl) {
    report_pair(DOTPLOT_DIR, lbl)$dot_plot +
        ggtitle(dotplot_pairs[[lbl]]) +
        theme_pub() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
              axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
              axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
              legend.position = "top",
              legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
              legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
              legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"))
})
names(dotplot_list) <- names(dotplot_pairs)

f4f = dotplot_list[["D011P03_vs_D119N01"]]
f4g = dotplot_list[["D018P05_vs_D113N10"]]
f4h = dotplot_list[["D112P05_vs_D014P08"]]

f4f
```

## E: Synteny vs complete reference

### 比对一致性

```{r}
#| label: synteny-identity
#| fig-cap: "MAG 与 WGS 完整基因组参考的平均比对一致性"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| out-width: 100%
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# 加载 MAG vs 完整基因组参考的共线性数据
genuses <- c("Pantoea", "Burkholderia")
synt_data <- lapply(genuses, function(g) {
  path <- file.path(SYNT_COMPLETE_DIR, paste0(g, "_synteny_summary.csv"))
  if (file.exists(path)) read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(Genus = g)
})
rearr <- lapply(genuses, function(g) {
  path <- file.path(SYNT_COMPLETE_DIR, paste0(g, "_rearrangements.csv"))
  if (file.exists(path)) read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(Genus = g)
})

# 固定 Genus 顺序（Pantoea 先于 Burkholderia），并提取物种简称作为分面
synt_all <- bind_rows(synt_data) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = factor(Genus, levels = genuses),
    Species = case_when(
      str_detect(query_species, "dispersa") ~ "P. dispersa",
      str_detect(query_species, "stewartii") ~ "P. stewartii",
      str_detect(query_species, "gladioli") ~ "B. gladioli"
    ),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("P. dispersa", "P. stewartii", "B. gladioli"))
  )

# 每个物种（参考菌株）的分面标签
ref_names <- synt_all %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(ref = first(reference), .groups = "drop") %>%
  { setNames(.$ref, .$Species) }

# 所有比对覆盖度均为 100%，故以平均比对一致性刻画 MAG 与参考的相似程度
f4i = synt_all %>%
  mutate(query = unname(bin_map[query])) %>%
  mutate(query = fct_reorder(query, mean_identity)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_identity, y = query, color = Genus)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Pantoea = "#4DBBD5", Burkholderia = "#E64B35")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(98, 99, 100), limits = c(98, 100)) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3,
             labeller = labeller(Species = ~ paste0(.x, "\nvs ", ref_names[.x]))) +
  labs(x = "Mean alignment identity (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 7))

f4i
```

### 结构重排事件

```{r}
#| label: synteny-rearrangements
#| fig-cap: "结构重排事件统计（MAG vs 完整基因组参考）"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: 100%
#| warning: false
#| message: false

rearr_all <- bind_rows(rearr)

f4j = synt_all %>%
  select(Species, n_inversions, n_gaps_10kb) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Species, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Metric = recode(Metric,
                         n_inversions = "Inversions",
                         n_gaps_10kb = "Gaps >10 kb")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Metric, y = Count, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, width = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Inversions" = "#E64B35",
                                "Gaps >10 kb" = "#4DBBD5")) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7))

f4j
```

## F: SNP & Indel vs complete reference

### SNP 密度分布 (4组)

```{r}
#| label: snp-density
#| fig-cap: "SNP 密度分布 (SNPs/kb) - MAG vs 完整基因组参考"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: 100%
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# 加载 Pantoea SNP 数据
pantoea_snp <- read_csv(file.path(SNP_COMPLETE_DIR, "Pantoea_snp_stats.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = "Pantoea",
    Group = case_when(
      query_species == "Pantoea dispersa" ~ "P. dispersa",
      query_species == "Pantoea stewartii" ~ "P. stewartii",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Group != "Unknown")

# 加载 Burkholderia 按染色体统计的数据
burkholderia_chrom_snp <- read_csv(file.path(SNP_COMPLETE_DIR, "Burkholderia_snp_chrom_stats.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(chromosome %in% c("Chr1", "Chr2")) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = "Burkholderia",
    Group = paste0("B. gladioli ", chromosome),
    total_snps = snps,
    snp_density_per_kb = density_per_kb,
    ti_tv_ratio = ti_tv_ratio
  )

# 合并数据（按丰度排序结果固定分类顺序：Pantoea 先于 Burkholderia，
# P. dispersa 先于 P. stewartii）
snp_complete_all <- bind_rows(
  pantoea_snp %>% select(Genus, Group, total_snps, snp_density_per_kb, ti_tv_ratio),
  burkholderia_chrom_snp %>% select(Genus, Group, total_snps, snp_density_per_kb, ti_tv_ratio)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = factor(Genus, levels = c("Pantoea", "Burkholderia")),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("P. dispersa", "P. stewartii",
                                     "B. gladioli Chr1", "B. gladioli Chr2"))
  )

snp_complete_valid <- snp_complete_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_snps), total_snps > 0)

# SNP 密度图 - 4组比较
f4k = snp_complete_valid %>%
  filter(snp_density_per_kb > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Group, y = snp_density_per_kb, fill = Genus)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "#333333") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Pantoea = "#4DBBD5", Burkholderia = "#E64B35")) +
  labs(y = "SNP density (SNPs/kb)", x = NULL) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

f4k
```

### Ti/Tv 比值分布 (4组)

```{r}
#| label: titv-ratio
#| fig-cap: "Ti/Tv 比值分布 - MAG vs 完整基因组参考"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: 100%
#| warning: false
#| message: false

f4l = snp_complete_valid %>%
  filter(ti_tv_ratio > 0, ti_tv_ratio < 10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Group, y = ti_tv_ratio, fill = Genus)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "#333333") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 1, label = "Ti/Tv = 1",
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray40") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 2, label = "Ti/Tv = 2",
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Pantoea = "#4DBBD5", Burkholderia = "#E64B35")) +
  labs(y = "Ti/Tv ratio", x = NULL) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

f4l
```

## 拼图

本章所有面板（A–L）组合为一张图。

```{r}
#| label: fig4-composite
#| fig-cap: "图4 组合图：(A) 分离株属级组成 (B) 扩增子vs分离方法比较 (C) 自交系vs农家种 (D) 内生vs外生 (E) 7 株完整基因组 ANI 热图 (F–H) mummer 种内共线性点图 (I) MAG vs 完整基因组比对一致性 (J) 结构重排事件 (K) SNP 密度 (L) Ti/Tv 比值"
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 10
#| out-width: 100%
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# 使用 patchwork 拼图：它会跨子图对齐绘图面板区域（plot panel），
# 因此 a / k / l 这类 x 轴文字长且倾斜的面板能与同行其他面板自动对齐，
# 这是 cowplot::plot_grid 处理旋转轴文字时容易错位的地方。
# 此处逐面板手动指定 tag（labs(tag=...)），编号与正文引用保持一致。
row1 = (f4a + labs(tag = "a")) | (f4b + labs(tag = "b")) |
       (f4c + labs(tag = "c")) | (f4d + labs(tag = "d"))

# 第二行：ANI 热图 + 3 个 mummer 点图；3 个点图共享同一 Orientation 图例
row2 = ((f4e + labs(tag = "e")) | (f4f + labs(tag = "f")) |
        (f4g + labs(tag = "g")) | (f4h + labs(tag = "h"))) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "top")

row3 = (f4i + labs(tag = "i")) | (f4j + labs(tag = "j")) |
       (f4k + labs(tag = "k")) | (f4l + labs(tag = "l"))

(row1 / row2 / row3) &
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
```
